title: Chapter 437 Wang Shuo Vs Sword God
content:
Chapter 437 Wang Shuo Vs Sword God

Wang Shuo immediately turned around and fled. It was obvious that Wang Shuo was no match for the Sword God.

Moreover, fighting in the city would hurt innocent people. Wang Shuo took advantage of the chaos and fled outside the city.

But the Sword God chased him relentlessly, and soon, Wang Shuo was caught up again.

"Little bastard, you still want to escape. Tell me, did you let the Ice Phoenix go?"

With this reminder, Wang Shuo simply released the Ice Phoenix.

At least the Ice Phoenix could share some of the Sword God's attacks.

Seeing the Sword God, the Ice Phoenix was also dumbfounded.

So soon, he came to the door.

"Master, let's go quickly, we can't beat him!"

Need you say, Wang Shuo released the Ice Phoenix just to delay a little time.

But the Sword God was much faster than Wang Shuo and the Ice Phoenix.

Wang Shuo had no chance to escape.

So, Wang Shuo turned around to meet the enemy.

Since he couldn't escape, Wang Shuo calmed down instead.

The Ice Phoenix suffered a great loss at his hands, and it has not recovered to its peak until now.

An ice spike condensed in the air and flew directly towards the Sword God.

The Sword God finally drew out his long sword and chopped it lightly, knocking the ice spike off.

Wang Shuo was no longer afraid, and activated the multiplication technique, kept his distance, released his ultimate move, and quickly stacked his passive.

With the joint efforts of the Ice Phoenix Emperor and Wang Shuo, they were able to barely block the Sword God's attack.

This surprised the Ice Phoenix Emperor.

This shouldn't be the case!

The Ice Phoenix Emperor soon reacted.

"Master, the Sword God must be injured!"

Hearing what the Ice Phoenix Emperor said, Wang Shuo felt a little relieved.

In the battle of Shenwu City, the Sword God also participated. Under the siege of many masters, he was already seriously injured.

Fortunately, after escaping, he was not blocked by the tracking masters, so he had a chance to breathe and recovered some strength.

At this time, he did not dare to use too much force, fearing that the old injury would relapse.

This gave Wang Shuo a chance.

Wang Shuo's anger gradually accumulated, and soon he turned on the red pupil state, and the speed of the iteration became higher and higher, almost doubling.

Wang Shuo was thinking, is it possible for his Shura Slash to hit the opponent?

And after hitting, is it possible to seriously injure the opponent?

Wang Shuo had never thought of killing, the strength of the strongest king must have a way to save his life.

After a long stalemate, the Sword God suddenly lost his patience.

A mid-level warrior, plus a star-level boss, actually fought with him for so long, it was a great shame.

So, he suppressed his injuries and broke out.

The long sword in his hand turned into the size of a door panel and quickly slashed at Wang Shuo.

Facing the powerful attack of the Sword God.

Wang Shuo did not dare to be arrogant and directly turned on the absolute defense.

He planned to take the opponent's attack head-on, and then confront the opponent head-on, accumulating anger at a faster speed.

The door-like long sword slashed at Wang Shuo. Although Wang Shuo was not injured, he was thrown hundreds of meters away by the huge force.

Logically speaking, Wang Shuo should have vomited blood, fallen to the ground, and even had multiple broken bones.

But Wang Shuo walked out of the smoke and dust as if nothing had happened.

The Sword God's eyes changed leisurely.

Could it be that this kid mainly practiced the skill of being beaten?

He was a little unconvinced. As a Sword God, could he not kill a mid-level warrior?

Even if he was injured, it would be a joke if it was spread out, which would damage his reputation as a Sword God.

You know, there are not many people with the title among so many strongest kings.

So he used his internal strength, and the magic sword in his hand flew out again, stabbing Wang Shuo's chest.

Not surprisingly, Wang Shuo could not avoid the Sword God's big move attack at all.
